chapter: Small band, Charlie Parker and the big band
title: Bird's first taste of the habit
summary: He says he thinks Bird first got into drugs while in the small band, but that Bird apparently kicked it before joining Harlan Leonard.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: But, Jay, was he hard to get along with when you had him in a small band?
Well, now, I'll tell you. I think that's when he first got his first taste, you know.
When he was with the small band?
With the small band. But he was making time.
But the reason I say when he first
got his first taste, because sometimes you see him do this on the stand, you know.
So I think that's when he got his first -- but he went, came back, started with Harlan. So he'd evidently kicked it.
